from: the author's picks in prototype-v95.html and prototype-v96.html, fixed in prototype-v97.html (no lists there)

click.title: Hover tick (Soft UI SFX)
click.note: CC BY: the author is credited on the site

crackle.title: single ticks of a flickering tube
crackle.note: one 85 ms grain on each of the twitch's two dips (0 and 141 ms), peak 0.22-0.34, pitch 0.94-1.08

hum.title: the lamp's hum under the pointer
hum.note: a seamless loop (last 0.4 s over the first), RMS 0.03, in 0.38 s with the flare, out 0.6 s

etudes-title.note: written, held 4 s, run back along the strokes, again; graphite with a hatched shadow

contact-dropdown.note: the package-version list in the mono face, the picked one marked with >

metta-ash-bg.note: tumbling ash flakes, the pointer stirs the air within 180 px

metta-ash-text.note: ash lies on the games' titles and lines (LoST/AB at the left + dust), wiped by hand, trembles with the logo

typing.note: Hover tick on every character, ~0.4 of the click, 120 ms, ±8 % pitch, deletions lower; never on touch screens

metta-sweep.title: hand brush small rocks
metta-sweep.note: grains of 90–160 ms from its sounding parts, following the wiping hand

header-tabs.note: the author unsure about the Études colour but ok; blue pencil dropped (blue is used nowhere else)

sound-default.note: starts with the first gesture; turning it off is remembered (localStorage persona-sound=off)
